# Chandler Pergola Co.

> Design-build studio for custom pergolas, patio covers, louvered roofs, ramadas, shade sails, outdoor kitchens and commercial shade structures in Chandler, Arizona and the Southeast Valley (Gilbert, Mesa, Queen Creek, Tempe). Every structure is designed around the home, engineered for desert heat and monsoon wind, and delivered permit- and HOA-ready. Free on-site design consultations.

## Contact
- Phone: 844-967-5247
- Email: josh@contractorschoiceagency.com
- Service area: Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Queen Creek, Tempe, Sun Lakes, Ahwatukee, San Tan Valley
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7am–6pm, free design consultations

## Services
- Custom Pergolas — cedar, powder-coated steel and aluminum pergolas designed for the desert: /services/custom-pergolas/
- Patio Covers — solid, lattice and insulated attached/freestanding covers that drop patio temps 15–20°F: /services/patio-covers/
- Alumawood & Aluminum Patio Covers — zero-maintenance wood-look aluminum that won't rot, warp or fade: /services/alumawood-aluminum-patio-covers/
- Louvered & Adjustable-Roof Pergolas — motorized aluminum louvers with rain sensors for shade on demand: /services/louvered-adjustable-pergolas/
- Ramadas & Gazebos — freestanding solid-roof Southwest shade retreats: /services/ramadas/
- Shade Sails & Sun Shades — architectural HDPE fabric shade cutting up to 95% of UV: /services/shade-sails-sun-shades/
- Outdoor Living & Outdoor Kitchens — built-in BBQ, bar, fireplace, lighting and fans under a rated roof: /services/outdoor-living-kitchens/
- Commercial Shade Structures — engineered, stamped steel and fabric shade for restaurants, HOAs, schools and offices: /services/commercial-shade-structures/

## Key Facts
- Local Chandler design-build; one crew designs, engineers and installs.
- Materials engineered for 115°F heat, UV and 60–70+ mph monsoon microbursts.
- Permits (City of Chandler and East Valley municipalities) and HOA/ARC approval handled for the client.
- Patio cover pricing in the East Valley: roughly $25/sq ft (lattice) up to ~$40/sq ft (insulated solid roof).
- No insurance products offered — this is a trade/contractor service.
